clean_text: What a wonderful opportunity that we have ahead of us here we are at the threshold of a very very important chance a crucial chance for us to redeem ourselves with allah subhanahu wa'ta'ala it's the month of repentance it's the month of fasting it's the month of prayer but most importantly it is the month of the quran that's what allah called it in the quran he said the month of ramadan and he defined it as saying in which the quran was revealed so we really need to not only fast not only pray not only be good but really focus on the quran and hone in on its meanings so in light of this i am excited to invite everyone for us to meet every day after salah we will have a series throughout the days of ramadan every single day after salah we will be discussing the tafsir of surat al-anbiya the 21st chapter of the quran why this chapter this chapter mentions the center thrust and the main point and the fulcrum upon which everything else in islam is hinged it mentions the commonalities between the calling and the religion of all of the prophets and the messengers it is a crucial chapter and we are going to look at it insha'allah under a different light through a different lens hopefully that we can almost kind of see it for the first time and as usual it will be presented mainly in english there will be some arabic as well spoken and it's very important for us to focus on the quran it's very important for us during this month to make the quran the absolute center of our thought and our being we need to meditate over its meanings we need to contemplate them reflect and hopefully this light will spill through our hearts and bring out a better person in all of us bring out our hope and reason so join us every day after swallow in surat al-anbiya it's very exciting very important for us to join this thank you very much may allah subhanahu wa'ta'ala bring out the best in every one of us during this month and grant us our full potential as foreign.

summary: This is an introduction to a Ramadan series focused on Tafseer (Quranic exegesis) of Surat Al-Anbiya (Chapter 21 of the Quran), presented by Sheikh Ali Mashhour. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that Ramadan is the month of the Quran and encourages the community to focus on understanding the Quran's meanings rather than just fasting and praying. The series will be held daily after Salah throughout Ramadan, examining Surat Al-Anbiya's central themes about the commonalities among all prophets and messengers, and the fundamental principles upon which Islam is built.
suggested_title: Ramadan Tafseer Series Introduction: Exploring Surat Al-Anbiya with Sheikh Ali Mashhour
